description: Guidance page for a compliance action — a statutory return or similar. Other content types may need different models.

caption.description: Optional plain text shown above the title

overview.description: Formatted text description of the task. HTML or Markdown

dueDate.description: The date the task must be completed by.

name.description: TBC - this set is a working assumption

label.description: User-facing text shown in the tag

steps.description: The process in the order the user must complete it.

importantDates.description: Optional relevant dates other than the due date.

importantDate.description: A relevant date other than the due date, e.g. when the collection opens.

label.description: Short text shown with the date, e.g. 'Census day'.

callToAction.description: a button linking the user onward, usually into the service.

step.description: A discrete step in the process

order.description: Explicit ordering, rather than relying on array position - allows reordering, filtering etc

body.description: Formatted text - HTML or markdown. Supports bullets, bold, links, visually hidden text

dateTag.description: An optional date tag shown against this step, eg 'Available 24 October'

prefix.description: Text shown before the date, eg 'Available', 'Due', etc

status.description: Status for this step, independent of page-level status - values TBC

label.description: User-facing text shown in the tag
